scope: Offline rigid-tool Newton-Euler bookkeeping over actual native rigid substeps; not TLMPM/interface energy convergence or hardware calibration
selection: All coupled_episode rows with explicit before-step tool pose, COM velocities, current NORMAL+FRICTION forces, actual mass/inertia and applied COM wrench; no residual-based exclusion
scale: Sum of norms of each constituent impulse, before vector cancellation; gravity, applied load and every normal/friction contact retained separately
budget_rationale: Finite engineering bookkeeping budgets fixed before actual force/velocity residuals are read. At the 2 ms rigid step the absolute terms correspond to 0.01 N and 0.0005 N m; the 5 percent term allows finite solver/integration error while retaining cancellation-sensitive support checks. Report all tails and accumulated residual even if this engineering screen passes.
required_bookkeeping: Actual mass and body-frame COM inertia read back from the rigid solver, with positive eigenvalues
Actual PRE and POST COM velocities and body orientations, world axes, SI, XYZW
Fresh current native contact sensor and tensor views with no capacity overflow or C++ invalidation logs
NORMAL and FRICTION forces on tool with their actual world contact points; no normal-only substitution
Applied wrench about actual PRE COM; gravity included once, no direct hidden hand/tool wrench
Unlisted loaded contact bodies or ambiguous velocity/inertia/point conventions cause NOT_SCORED rather than passing
lab_extension: Use consecutive actual MJWarp COM velocities/body orientations and signed shape0 contact wrenches only when same-interval contact/apply timestamps and actual model properties can be established; otherwise NOT_SCORED with reason. No fitted sign, scale, shift or frame chosen from residuals.
report: Every selected row and input hash
Absolute residual p50/p95/p99/max and normalized budget usage
